summary: The Caldwell Garden Room is an exceptional double-fronted detached family home, thoughtfully designed to combine contemporary living with generous proportions and a strong emphasis on light, space, and versatility. INCENTIVES AVAILABLE
description:
This outstanding four-bedroom new-build residence offers an impressive layout, perfectly suited to the demands of modern family life, while providing a stylish and welcoming environment throughout. A standout feature of this home is the beautifully appointed garden room, adding an additional living space that enhances both the flexibility and character of the property. At the heart of the home lies the superb open-plan kitchen, dining, and family area, flooded with natural light and designed as a vibrant central hub for everyday living and entertaining. Featuring elegant double doors that open directly onto the private rear garden, this space creates a seamless connection between indoors and outdoors, making it ideal for hosting and enjoying long summer evenings. The ground floor also benefits from a separate, well-proportioned lounge, offering a more formal or tranquil retreat, alongside a dedicated study that provides excellent versatility and could be utilised as a fifth bedroom if required. A practical utility room adds everyday convenience, while a spacious entrance hallway with ample storage and a downstairs cloakroom/W.C. further enhances the thoughtful design of the home. Ascending to the first floor, the property continues to impress with four generously sized bedrooms, each offering comfortable and flexible accommodation. The principal bedroom enjoys the benefit of a private en-suite shower room, creating a peaceful and well-appointed retreat. The remaining bedrooms are served by a contemporary family bathroom, designed to accommodate the needs of a busy household. Externally, the property boasts a block-paved driveway providing ample off-road parking, together with access to a detached double garage offering additional parking and storage. To the rear, a fully enclosed and landscaped garden provides a private and versatile outdoor space, perfect for relaxation, entertaining, and family enjoyment. The Caldwell Garden Room represents an outstanding opportunity to acquire a spacious, high-quality home that effortlessly combines style, practicality, and modern living. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this exceptional property has to offer.

THE DEVELOPMENT Life at Westpark Garden Village offers a superb balance of convenience, community, and outdoor living, making it an desirable setting for modern family life. Ideally positioned, the development allows residents to enjoy a wealth of amenities quite literally on the doorstep, with Westpark Village just a short stroll away. Here, you'll find an excellent selection of everyday essentials and lifestyle conveniences, including a café, bakery, Marks & Spencer, and Aldi, alongside a welcoming local pub-perfect for relaxed family meals or socialising with friends. Everything you need is within easy reach, enhancing both practicality and quality of life. For those who appreciate the outdoors, Westpark is particularly appealing. A network of scenic walking routes weaves throughout the area, offering the perfect setting for morning strolls, dog walking, or simply unwinding in nature. The nearby park provides a tranquil escape, where you can take in picturesque surroundings before heading home-ideal for balancing work and leisure, especially for those working remotely. Community lies at the very heart of Westpark Garden Village, creating a welcoming and family-friendly environment where neighbours quickly become familiar faces. Whether it's enjoying the green open spaces, visiting local amenities, or simply embracing the relaxed pace of life, this is a location designed to enrich everyday living.

LOCAL AREA Westpark is an ongoing development and a thriving community made up of residential homes and a vibrant commercial village centre. Amenities include an M&S Foodhall, Aldi supermarket, Convenience store, Bakery, Café, Hair and Beauty salon, Dentist, Pharmacy and The White Heifer that Travelled Pub. There is also an excellent Primary and Children's nursery school plus Westpark Hospital. It is enhanced further by thirty-three acres of stunning open Parkland to explore and enjoy. Juniper Avenue is directly adjacent to the earlier phases of Westpark and is located on the northeast side of Edward Pease Way. The western and northern boundaries of the development are adjacent to the A1(M) and A68 providing excellent links to the transport networks. The East Coast mainline is perfect for those needing to commute for work or leisure. The local bus services run frequently into Darlington Town Centre and beyond.
